notes.title: Movement Rework! - Completed
notes.content:
Added Sliding, Wall Jumping , Climbing. 
*/ All activated via the Space Bar. Slide is what was the crouch button. *\

Crouching is now removed. 

Reworked the ADS for non scoped weapons. 

Increased Movement Speed as per player request. 

Removed movement lock for reloading .

notes.title: New Movement System !
notes.content: A new parkour style movement system , along with some additional changes to the aiming mode. Some guns now aim more traditionally.

notes.title: Release Stage 1
notes.content:
Most of the game systems are in place. Weapons and graphics will continue to be improved , along with further content. 

Update Includes: 
Single Player Mode 
2 New Maps 
New menu and loadout system 
Character Abilities 
Graphical and functional rework.. 

Plus much more! 

Thank you for your support !
